g.title: ECU_16PIN
g.text: MaxxECU M50 terminated harness — 16-pin aux breakout
CAN H/L (pins 10/9) shared with Gauge.S — see CAN_BUS_JUNCTION in maxxecu-m52.wv.

g.title: W_8HP_CAN_CABIN
g.text: Twisted pair, 22 AWG. From cabin CAN junction to bulkhead cabin side.

g.title: BULKHEAD_PASS
g.text: Relevant pins only; see firewall-bulkhead.wv for full 79-pin diagram

g.title: W_8HP_CAN_ENGINE
g.text: Twisted pair, 22 AWG. Bulkhead engine side to 8HP TCU (MaxxECU GEN1 harness).

g.title: POWERHOLD_RELAY
g.text: Constant +12V — KL30 supply for 8HP TCU. See power-distribution.wv.
Must remain live from first key-on. ECU must NOT cut this relay during run.

g.title: CHASSIS_GND
g.text: Chassis / battery GND — cabin distribution bar

g.title: HP8_TCU
g.text: Full connector is multi-pin ZF proprietary. MaxxECU 8HP GEN1 harness required.

Full harness assembly: MaxxECU 8HP GEN1 CAN harness kit ~$368. Source: maxxecu.com/store/gearbox/8hp/maxxecu-8hp-gen1-cable-harness MTune: Advanced :: 8HP :: enable. Set ratio table from ZF 8HP70 spec. 120Ω CAN terminator fitted at TCU end (included in MaxxECU harness kit).
